method: Independent committed-byte and arithmetic audit of supplied evidence; no predictor or raw-capture rerun.

capture.count_basis: Prior full-capture streamed descriptor inventory; this review verified four retained rows and arithmetic without rescanning raw capture.

execution_scope: The complete 93-layer graphs were constructed and checked, not all executed.
Actual Engine executions use the first two original-geometry layers, retaining dense and routed/shared expert paths and the complete four-DP cohort.

Small execution controls explicitly select steady_matmul, aggregate probability grouped envelope and causal ring/pairwise transports. They establish conservation and dependencies, not expert tiling accuracy.
This explicit source-compatible declaration does not establish the captured binary, source factory flags or historical runtime selection.
No measurement durations, weights, accelerator execution or timing multipliers are inputs.

limitations: The candidate generator uses source-caller point state, not a complete frontend prediction.
The separate integration evidence constructs full 93-layer graphs; engine executions cover first two layers.
Both T1024 descriptors retain all 82 source-compatible candidates; the four-event descriptor is not assigned to layer zero.
Both T1 descriptors retain all 41 candidates; 14020 events do not close 75 times 187 calls.
Flattened allocations and optional fallback tensors do not prove active views, bank strides or flags.
No candidate was selected by event duration; no layer, replica, phase or step identity was inferred.
Reference activity sums omit attention, FFN, collectives, embedding, logits/final norm and host dispatch.
Current checkpoint and source-compatible selection do not prove historical capture factory flags.
